name: Craig C. Martin
tagline: Top rated Business Litigation attorney in Chicago, Illinois
about: Craig C. Martin is an attorney who represents clients in the Chicago, Illinois area. Craig Martin is recognized by peers and was selected to Super Lawyers for 2005 - 2027. This selection is based off of an evaluation of 12 indicators including peer recognition and professional achievement in legal practice.

Craig Martin chose to pursue a career in law after completing undergraduate studies. He attended Harvard Law School and graduated in 1989. Craig Martin passed the bar exam and was admitted to legal practice in 1988.
He represents clients with Business Litigation issues in Illinois.

Being selected to Super Lawyers is limited to a small number of attorneys in each state. As one of the few attorneys to garner the distinction of Super Lawyers, Craig Martin has earned the respect of peers as one of the top-rated attorneys in the nation.

The Super Lawyers patented selection process is peer influenced and research driven, selecting the top 5% of attorneys to the Super Lawyers lists each year. We know lawyers and make it easy to connect with them.
